East, the veteran " junior " was well up and walking in fine style, A.
The end was now in sight, but with Alf Cotton coming through the field and bringing with him his clubmate Bob Goodall, Woodford were now coming to challenge us.

Hugh McGreechan, who was third last year, made himself a very worthy winner this year, and had the satisfaction of making his own pace throughout to win quite comfortably by five minutes from Alf Cotton—who won the Woodford 20—and from George Checkley, who took 2nd place in our Championship.
Congratulations to George Oliver on winning the Civil Service Road Walking championship, and he beat R. Carpenter, the holder, with A.

Our lesser hopes in the 50kms walk were confirmed although Alf Cotton and John Proctor walked well to finish 5th and 6th. The superiority of the Russian women in the power events was early established by Nina Doumbadze in the women's discus, winning by some six metres from her nearest rival.
